Each tile has an area of \( 4 \, \text{square feet} \).

To find out how many tiles are required to cover the entire floor, we divide the total area of the room by the area covered by one tile:

Number of tiles (\( N \)) =
\[ N = \frac{\text{Total Area}}{\text{Tile Area}} = \frac{24}{4} = 6 \]

Therefore, Jesse needs 6 tiles to cover her whole floor completely.
